title: 🏆 10-Day A+ Exam Sprint (PRS + IRS)
description: The unified interactive learning playground designed to guarantee an A+ in Pattern Recognition Systems and Intelligent Reasoning Systems. Synergistic 4-hour daily modules with zero-math-fear visualizers.

modules.title: Day 1: Foundations of Perception, Search & Classifiers
modules.subtitle: LLMs vs Reasoning, A* Search & CSP Heuristics, k-NN, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes Laplace & Confusion Matrix/Lift
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 2: Signals, Sampling & Rule-Based Reasoning
modules.subtitle: Nyquist Sampling & Aliasing, arPLS Baseline Drift, Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) & Hospital Emergency Triage Rule Engine
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 3: Frequency Transforms, STFT & Bayesian Reasoning
modules.subtitle: Fourier Paradox, STFT Spectrograms, Wavelets MRA, Bayesian Belief Networks & Cognitive Architectures (ACT-R / SOAR)
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 4: Geometric Boundaries, Dimensionality & CBR
modules.subtitle: Support Vector Machines (Kernels & Margins), PCA vs LDA, Sensor Energy Compaction & Case-Based Reasoning (CBR)
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 5: Clustering, Latent Factors & Recommenders
modules.subtitle: K-Means, Hierarchical Linkage, DBSCAN, Market Basket Analysis (Apriori), Collaborative Filtering & Matrix Factorization
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 6: Deep Learning: Perceptrons, MLPs & Convolutions
modules.subtitle: Perceptrons, Backpropagation, Gradient Descent, Activations (ReLU/Softmax), CNN Filters, Pooling & CIFAR-10
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 7: Sequences, Time Series & Language Models
modules.subtitle: Vanishing Gradients, LSTM Gating (Forget/Input/Output), 1D-CNNs, Word2Vec, GloVe & Semantic Embedding Spaces
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 8: Transformers, Knowledge Graphs & GraphRAG
modules.subtitle: Self-Attention, Multi-Head Transformers, Knowledge Graph Embeddings (TransE / PyKEEN), Neo4j Cypher & Graph-RAG
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 9: Evolutionary Optimization, Multimodal Fusion & Cognitive Agents
modules.subtitle: Genetic Algorithms (WS1GA.xlsx), Multimodal RVM Sensor Fusion, Cognitive Memory Maps (ACT-R / SOAR) & ReAct Agents
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 3 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)

modules.title: Day 10: Ensembles, Grand Synthesis & Full A+ Mock Exam
modules.subtitle: Bagging, Boosting (AdaBoost), Stacking Meta-Learners, RS Escape Room & 20-Question Comprehensive Grand Mock Exam
modules.duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 3 Interactive Studios + 20 Grand Exam Quizzes)
